rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 24px.
Ensure strong hierarchy by jumping at least one scale step between heading and subheading.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for large background areas; use tinted zinc greys.
Status colors must be highly vibrant to stand out on cheap phone screens.
Primary actions use inverted high-contrast colors (Black in light mode, White in dark mode) to act as visual anchors.
Ensure 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio for text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)' for dashboard cards. Flat backgrounds with crisp 1px borders and no soft shadows. Sharp edges (rounded-md max).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to zero shadows. Rely on border contrast for depth.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border/60 on cards and list items. Highlight active states with 2px border of primary color.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react with standard stroke-width (2px), sizing at 20px or 24px.

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar (`bottom-0 w-full`) with 4-5 key destinations (Home, Khata, Inventory, Suppliers). Large tap targets (min-h-[64px]). pb-safe padding.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
dashboard_grid.spans: Summary metric cards take col-span-1. Charts take col-span-1 md:col-span-2. Activity feeds take col-span-1 row-span-2.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous padding inside cards: p-4 for dense lists, p-6 for summary cards. Ensure touch targets are at least 48px high.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (`rounded-md`). MUST have active states: `active:scale-95` to simulate haptic feedback. Large sizing: `h-12` or `h-14` for primary mobile buttons.
components.cards: Flat, cardless feel or 1px border. No heavy drop shadows.
components.aging_chips: Small badges for Khata dues. Colors: 0-30 days (Green bg/text), 31-60 days (Amber bg/text), 60+ days (Red bg/text). Use highly visible saturated backgrounds with contrasting text.
components.toasts: Use `sonner` for all success/error notifications (e.g., 'Reminder Sent', 'Payment Recorded'). Position bottom-center on mobile.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Minimal grid lines. Tooltips must be large and legible.

motion_and_interactions.haptics: Simulate haptics via CSS: `active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-100` on all tap targets (buttons, list items, cards).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in for page content (`animate-in fade-in duration-300`).
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered entrance for Khata and Inventory lists if using Framer Motion, otherwise simple CSS fade.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-shadow on text over images.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` to all buttons, links, inputs, and key data points (e.g., `data-testid='record-sale-btn'`).
accessibility.language: UI must support Hindi/English toggle. Store preference in context/localStorage.

shop_placeholder.description: A store front with many items on display, suitable for default shop profile or empty inventory background.

empty_ledger.description: An open ledger book, perfect for Khata empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Initialize Tailwind with Outfit and Inter fonts. Set up Dark Mode via next-themes (or similar) with system default auto-switch. Configure Sonner for toasts.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Build a layout with a responsive shell: Bottom Nav on mobile (<768px), Sidebar on desktop (>=768px).
instructions_to_main_agent.khata_feature: Build the ledger with color-coded aging chips prominently displayed on customer rows. Implement a 'Send Reminder' button with a simulated WhatsApp icon.
instructions_to_main_agent.inventory_feature: Create a list view for inventory with 'Low Stock' warnings highlighted in red/amber.
instructions_to_main_agent.ocr_feature: Mock the Bill OCR flow with a file upload input that transitions to a 'Confirm Extracted Line Items' screen.
instructions_to_main_agent.language_toggle: Create a context provider for i18n to toggle between English and Hindi strings for major UI elements.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Implement Recharts for the analytics view (daily sales, dues aging distribution).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container; do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, active states (scale down), and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. It is located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
